annotation.summary_en: A man pretends to go on a five-day business trip to deceive his wife, only to spend the time with another woman in the same apartment building.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins in an apartment where a man dressed in a suit is preparing for a supposed five-day business trip. His wife, wearing a pink bathrobe and a towel on her head, helps him pack, ensuring he has his 'slippers with mustaches.' They share a melodramatic, emotional farewell, sitting down briefly for the traditional pre-travel moment of silence. The man acts overly sensitive, telling her not to look at him with such sad eyes as he leaves. However, the visual narrative reveals his deception: instead of leaving the building, he simply travels between floors in the same apartment complex. He is seen lounging in bed with another woman in a tank top, enjoying his 'trip.' At one point, he is seen shirtless in the stairwell carrying a red bucket, as his wife tasks him with taking out the trash since he 'got carried away' with the emotional goodbye. The sketch satirizes infidelity and the laziness of a husband who uses a fake business trip to stay just a few flights of stairs away from home.
catchphrases: մի նայի տենց ինձ մի նայի
